# EasyReview

> EasyReview helps local businesses turn happy customers into 5-star Google reviews with QR codes, while routing unhappy feedback privately before it reaches Google. The same app also includes EasyMenu, EasyStory, EasyProfile, and EasyCash.

EasyReview is a review-growth product for local businesses in India and beyond. Customers scan a counter QR, rate their visit, get AI-drafted review text for 4–5★ experiences, or submit private feedback for 1–3★. EasyMenu is a digital menu, EasyStory makes posters for WhatsApp Status and Instagram Stories, EasyProfile is a digital business card, and EasyCash makes GST invoices and tracks income and expenses. Each product has its own plan; EasyCash is free.
